game_concept: A arcade set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Well, a frozen village well: the hold guard must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Spell Forge: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against yeti raiders.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Well: a frozen village well
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Well, repeat each round: Define a function once, then call it to cast the same spell repeatedly against yeti raiders. Each round, a new firewood challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the spells value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 150 points of firewood by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 150, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 4 (applied tier): Spell Forge
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Spell Forge' (Week 6 slot 1), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Frozen Well'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how spells changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Frozen Well.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 150 within 55 seconds.
